label: token right after a 3 early in the original sequence (positions 2-4)
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase on the step immediately after the digit 3 was input, when that step is t=2..4 (so the 3 was at position 1-3). Steps with prev_tok=3 at t=2 and t=3 are almost always active (precision 1.0 and 0.97 on dev). At t=4 it is less reliable (precision ~0.6), and at t>=5 it is mostly silent. The strongest activations come from sequences that start n 3 3 ...: about 0.4 of max on the second 3 and near max on the token after it. Sequences that start with n or w raise the firing rate. The token being input at the current step has little effect. It never fires at t=0/1, in the copy phase, or (with negligible exceptions) on the delimiter. About 17% of activation mass is weak, diffuse firing at t=3-4 that does not follow a 3. This is why count recall is only ~0.57 while mass recall is ~0.83.

issues: The main claims check out on dev. prev_tok=3: precision 1.00 at t=2, 0.97 at t=3, 0.59 at t=4 and 0.08 at t=5. Copy-phase activity is exactly 0. The delimiter holds 0.3% of the mass. t=0 and t=1 never fire. Max-activation examples are 'n 3 3 X' (about 0.40 on the second 3, about 1.0 on X). Original predicate on test: P 0.870, R 0.566, F1 0.685, mass recall 0.828.

Systematic miss: the 'weak, diffuse' firing at t=3-4 that does not follow a 3 is not diffuse. It clusters in sequences whose first token is n (or w). Predicate (phase==0)&(prev_tok!=3)&(t in 3..4)&(first_tok==n) has test precision 0.44 and covers 17.7% of all active steps (8.7% of mass). Adding w raises this to precision 0.34 and 27% of active steps. The base rate for these steps is about 3%, so this is a second mode. The explanation only says first_tok n/w raises the firing rate of the after-3 mode.
This n-start mode does not depend on a 3 or any digit having been seen. Precision is 0.43 with no 3 seen and 0.44 with no digits seen, so it cannot be folded into 'after a 3'.
The label overclaims at t=4. With prev_tok=3 at t=4 precision is only 0.59 (test 0.61), and those steps carry about 10% of the mass, so 'positions 2-4' is solid only for 2-3.
Minor: a 3 that follows an earlier 3 (n_seen(3)>1) fires less reliably (precision 0.55). Example test false positives: '3 3 b 3 *b*' and 'i 3 i 3 *3*' at t=4.
Adding the n-start mode as an OR term raises test F1 from 0.685 to 0.720 and mass recall from 0.83 to 0.915.
skeptic.revised_label: early original-phase feature: the token right after the digit 3 at positions 2-3 (weaker at 4), plus a weaker secondary mode at positions 3-4 in sequences that start with 'n' (or 'w')

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & prev_tok=3 (+9.90), orig0=n (+7.59), t=3 & prev_tok=3 (+6.71), orig0=w (+6.32), orig0=0 (+5.52), orig0=a (+5.29). Lower it: orig0=3 (-7.17), t=6 (-6.30), prev_tok=n (-5.72), prev_tok=0 (-5.49).
